g.text: C. Total observed GPU execution spans, separately profiled groups
Milliseconds per task; interval unions, not pure shader busy time
Thread-only has no GPU prefill during tools, yet producer wall can stall by1.76s; ready proxies and negatives retained.
Token-only and per-batch controls are in report/CSV. Bare and marker are separate; do not subtract their bar medians.
No snapshot/eviction; no competing-PID or full-device scheduler attribution. Default unchanged.
